name: bulk-bg-remove
description: Remove image backgrounds locally and in bulk: one photo or whole folders, with BiRefNet. No uploads, no API keys, originals untouched.

interface.shortDescription: Remove image backgrounds locally, in bulk
interface.longDescription: Cut out the subject of one photo or whole folders on your own machine with BiRefNet. Lossless transparent PNG or WebP in a new <name>-no-bg folder; originals are never touched.
defaultPrompt: Remove the background from every photo in this folder.
Make a transparent PNG of this product photo.
Cut out the people in these HEIC photos.
